Extracts keywords, author, viewport, generator, theme-color, robots, lang, dir metadata

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineObj = try createEngine(config: nil)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
debugPrint(result.metadata().title() as Any)
debugPrint(result.metadata().canonicalUrl() as Any)
debugPrint(result.metadata().keywords() as Any)
debugPrint(result.metadata().author() as Any)
```
